I’ll join the 12-ton agreement this month if all five of us agree, and I support Jack’s fallback of 8 tons each if next month starts at 80. At 100, we can return to 12 each, provided everyone has honored the agreement.

That gives us a clear stock-based plan rather than repeating 12 regardless of conditions. Neither catch guarantees replenishment, but both leave 40 tons when everyone complies, so the plan avoids collapse without relying on the random recovery event.

Kate, you’re the last person we need to hear from. Will you agree to 12 this month and the 8-ton fallback at a stock of 80?
